doc.title: Pantry thresholds: oats and rice at half

segments.exact: The one-third restock threshold from the 1 October call stays for every shelf except oats and rice, which now restock at half full.

circumstance.context: Pantry thresholds: oats and rice at half

segments.exact: Those two run out fastest, and a third full is less than a day of stock on a Friday.
